create_metric_base: create a Metric base class with abstract initialize, update, value, and reset methods for TensorFlow metrics
build_sum_metric: build a Sum metric class that calculates the element-wise sum of given TensorFlow tensor values
build_mean_metric: build a Mean metric class that calculates the element-wise mean of given TensorFlow tensor values
test_metric_call: test the Metric __call__ method that updates the metric and returns the new value
review_metric_reset: review the Metric reset method that resets accumulated metric state to zero
